title: Repair promotion bootstrap when rollback root already exists
head_binding_policy: The final PR head SHA is bound by REVIEW_HEAD_SHA at independent reviewer approval time via scripts/git/task_review_merge_gate.py. This evidence manifest does not claim a commit can contain its own SHA.
no_live_rollout_boundary: Only repairs same-root immutable rollback runtime materialization in scripts/promote_supervisor_runtime.py without executing live rollout or supervisor process restart.
normal_revert_plan: Revert the commit on dev if candidate runtime identity verification or rollback materialization behavior regresses.

abort_evidence_and_root_analysis.abort_reason: Controlled promotion of dev merge f8c212d5 aborted before changing config because legacy mutable incumbent already occupied command-runtimes/5877... and materialize_immutable_rollback_runtime failed to handle existing same-root destination.
abort_evidence_and_root_analysis.safety_analysis: Reusing existing destination is safe ONLY if candidate identity matches snapshot (same root, same device/inode, same head commit, same tree identity, same accepted dev commit, same repo) and passes verify_immutable_snapshot(). Moving running root or accepting arbitrary existing roots remains unsafe and rejected.
